ns2:section.sectionText: The course will explore the rise and fall of the British novel. By examining such themes as development, the marriage contract, innovation, and experimentation, we?ll observe how the novel first came into being in the United Kingdom. We?ll also study the diverse social, cultural, and psychic needs that the novel has served throughout its lifespan, and how it evolved into the dominant literary genre in the language. Requirements for the course will include active class participation, a daily reading journal, two major exams and two 8-10 page essays.
